## Dependencies that changed after your training data

Your training data (`claude-sonnet-4-5`, cutoff 2025-07-31) predates the versions this project pins. When a note below conflicts with what you remember, follow the note: it describes the installed version. Tags: [types] = diff of the published type declarations, [changelog] = release notes, [guide] = the package's upgrade guide, [summary] = summary of both.

**typescript** 5.8.3 → 7.0.2 (major)
- `CompilerOptions` options removed: `allowSyntheticDefaultImports`, `alwaysStrict`, `baseUrl`, `charset`, `downlevelIteration`, `importsNotUsedAsValues`, `keyofStringsOnly`, `noStrictGenericChecks` (+7 more). [types]
- Since 6.0, `rootDir` defaults to the directory containing `tsconfig.json` instead of being inferred from the common source directory. Output lands in `dist/src/index.js` unless you set `"rootDir": "./src"` explicitly, or `"../src"` when including files outside the tsconfig directory. [guide]
- `baseUrl` is gone and no longer acts as a module lookup root. Remove it and prefix each `paths` entry instead, e.g. `"@app/*": ["./src/app/*"]`. Add `"*": ["./src/*"]` only if bare imports really relied on `baseUrl` lookup. [guide]
- `moduleResolution: node` (alias `node10`) is deprecated in 6.0 and removed in 7.0. Use `nodenext` for Node.js, or `bundler` for bundlers and Bun; `bundler` may now be combined with `module: commonjs`. [guide]
- `moduleResolution: classic` has been removed. Use `nodenext` or `bundler`. [guide]
- `noUncheckedSideEffectImports` now defaults to `true`, so side-effect imports like `import "./styles.css"` must resolve. Set it to `false` to keep the old behavior. [guide]
- `esModuleInterop` and `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` can no longer be `false`; interop is always on. Write `import express from "express"` instead of `import * as express from "express"`. [guide]
- The `module` values `amd`, `umd`, `systemjs` and `none` are no longer supported, and `/// <amd-module>` has no effect. Emit ESM (`esnext`/`preserve`) or `commonjs` and use a bundler. [guide]

**better-auth** 1.2.12 → 1.7.11
- `c7d2253` Rewrite the generic OAuth plugin as a first-class social provider with OAuth 2.1 security defaults. Providers now use `signIn.social` + `callback/:id` instead of dedicated plugin endpoints, with PKCE required by default (OAuth 2.… [changelog]
- `652fa53` The dynamic `baseURL` config now ignores `x-forwarded-host` and `x-forwarded-proto` unless you set `advanced.trustedProxyHeaders: true`. Requests using `baseURL: { allowedHosts }` now resolve the auth origin from `Host` by defaul… [changelog]
- `845bbd1` `auth migrate` no longer attempts to add a required column with no default value to a table that already has rows. It stops with an error naming the column and the backfill to run first. Previously the generated statement failed… [changelog]
- `e53582c` The MCP plugin moves out of `better-auth` into its own package, `@better-auth/mcp`, built on `@better-auth/oauth-provider`. Import the authorization plugin and protected-request helpers from the package root. The in-core MCP clie… [changelog]
- `fe4c820` `npx auth migrate` no longer aborts when adding a column to an existing table. A required column with a default value, or a unique column, now migrates on SQLite and on populated Postgres and MySQL databases. Upgrading a database… [changelog]
- `0c3856f` `getCookieCache` now returns `null` for an expired session instead of the stale session data. Middleware that calls it to gate access no longer treats an expired signed cookie as a live session. [changelog]
- Generic OAuth now uses the social-provider path, so the provider callback URL moved from `/api/auth/oauth2/callback/:id` to `/api/auth/callback/:id`. Re-register it at each provider, call `signIn.social({ provider })` instead of `signIn.oauth2({ providerId })`, use `linkSocial()` instead of `oauth2.link()`, and drop `genericOAuthClient()`. [guide]
- In genericOAuth provider configs, PKCE now defaults to on (previously off), and issuer validation is automatic. Set `pkce: false` only for providers that reject PKCE, and remove `issuer` and `requireIssuerValidation`. [guide]
